verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail claims native mail automation rules ('Set up automation rules and have it handled exactly how you want'). It also offers a Zapier integration and an API for background workflows, but all of this rests on brief marketing claims with no detail on what the rules do. Richer, triggered automation appears to depend on external tooling (Zapier, or custom code against the API). Probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: documented rule triggers and actions (e.g. auto-scan, auto-forward, auto-deposit), detail on scheduling and webhooks, a published API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run unattended.
